summary: Server request to prepare a list of spells for a player character, drained by esv::SpellSystem::ProcessPlayerPrepares (bg3.exe+0x338B770; Toolkit EoCServer.dll), which calls esv::SpellSystem::PlayerPrepareSpell for every element (eoc::spell::MetaId, 0x30 bytes) and, when the flag is set, first gathers and unprepares the character's current prepared spells. Also written by esv::party_preset::System::SystemLoad (macOS lambda $_4). Registered as an ordinary component despite the name. Never seen alive. Registry total 24 (server row).
